text: U.S. stocks are trading higher today, with the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq Composite building on record highs set in the previous session. Market sentiment remains supported by strong corporate earnings and optimism regarding potential diplomatic progress toward easing the conflict in Iran, which has helped stabilize energy markets. While the broader market is positive, the technology sector is seeing mixed results; shares of companies like SpaceX and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) are lagging due to investor concerns over heavy artificial intelligence-related spending and earnings that failed to meet high expectations, respectively.
